def setup_sudo(u):

    need(stat.S_ISDIR(root.st_mode) and root.st_uid==0 and not root.st_mode&0o022,'SETUP_ROOT_CUSTODY_REFUSED')

               'uid':root.st_uid,'gid':root.st_gid,'links':root.st_nlink}]
    while pending:
        name=pending.pop(0)
        if name in ('','.'):continue
        if name=='..':path=path.parent;continue
        candidate=path/name;info=candidate.lstat()
        need(info.st_uid==0,'SETUP_SUDO_OWNERSHIP_REFUSED')
        observed.append({'path':str(candidate),'device':info.st_dev,'inode':info.st_ino,
                         'mode':info.st_mode,'uid':info.st_uid,'gid':info.st_gid,'links':info.st_nlink})
        if stat.S_ISLNK(info.st_mode):
            links+=1;target=os.readlink(candidate)
            need(links<=16 and len(target.encode())<=4096,'SETUP_SUDO_ALIAS_BOUND')
            observed[-1]['target_sha256']=digest(os.fsencode(target))
            target_path=Path(target)
            if target_path.is_absolute():path=Path('/');parts=target_path.parts[1:]
            else:parts=target_path.parts
            pending=list(parts)+pending
        else:
            need(not info.st_mode&0o022 and (stat.S_ISDIR(info.st_mode) if pending else stat.S_ISREG(info.st_mode)),
                 'SETUP_SUDO_ANCESTRY_REFUSED')
            path=candidate

    # administrative-setup target, never a non-setid native transport admission.
    need(path in (Path('/usr/bin/sudo'),Path('/usr/bin/sudo-rs'),
                  Path('/usr/bin/sudo.ws'),Path('/usr/lib/cargo/bin/sudo')),

         stat.S_IMODE(info.st_mode)==0o4755,'SETUP_SUDO_PROFILE_REFUSED')
    raw=u.checked_file(path,64*1024*1024,single_link=False)
    return {'bytes':len(raw),'sha256':digest(raw),'mode':0o4755,'uid':0,

           'source_commit':SOURCE_COMMIT,'source_tree':SOURCE_TREE,

         and all(type(value[k]) is type(v) and value[k]==v for k,v in fixed.items())
         and type(value['mode']) is str and value['mode'] in ('legacy','dag')
         and raw==module.canonical(value),'FAILED_LEG_SELECTION_BINDING')
    root=evidence/'leg-observations';fd=module.private_directory(root);os.close(fd)
    expected=['legacy'] if value['mode']=='legacy' else ['legacy','dag']

    # A journal interrupted after reservation may precede its outcome update.

    result={'schema':'dg16.full-pair-failed-leg-observation.v1','authority':'NONE','mode':value['mode'],

            'original_acceptance':False,'Q02':False}
    rendered=canonical(result)

def failed_leg_public_budget(state,u):
    """Reserve the additional failed-operation path before either canonical leg."""
    need((u.FILE_LIMIT,u.TOTAL_LIMIT,u.LINE_LIMIT,u.LOG_LIMIT)==(65536,262144,262144,1048576),
         'FAILED_LEG_INHERITED_PUBLIC_LIMITS')
    docs=state['docs'];names=set(PUBLIC_NAMES)-{'ARTIFACT_MANIFEST.json'}
    need(set(docs)==names,'FAILED_LEG_PUBLIC_POPULATION')
    base={name:len(u.public_codec(name,docs[name])) for name in names}
    # The unchanged failure path can replace an unreceivable native projection by None.
    fallback=dict(docs['PROBE.json'],native_prerequisite=None)
    base['PROBE.json']=max(base['PROBE.json'],len(u.public_codec('PROBE.json',fallback)))
    # Full success keeps the inherited preview/final gate and no rich failure
    # projection. A failed canonical leg never reaches a live preview/hold.
    need(base['PROBE.json']<=16384,'FAILED_LEG_PROBE_PREFIX_BOUND')
    future={'PROBE.json':47104,'FAILURE.json':32768+12288,'HOST.json':14*2304,
            'RESULT.json':2048,'SOURCE.json':512,'CLEANUP.json':512}
    maximum={name:base[name]+future[name] for name in names};maximum['ARTIFACT_MANIFEST.json']=2048
    reserve=2000
    semantic={name:public_semantic_size(u,name,u.public_codec(name,docs[name]))+future[name] for name in names}
    semantic['PROBE.json']+=2048;semantic['FAILURE.json']+=1045;semantic['CLEANUP.json']+=512;semantic['ARTIFACT_MANIFEST.json']=2048
    need(all(size<=81920 for size in semantic.values()) and sum(semantic.values())<=u.TOTAL_LIMIT-reserve,'FAILED_LEG_SEMANTIC_CAPACITY_UNAVAILABLE')
    need(all(size<=u.FILE_LIMIT-reserve for size in maximum.values())
         and sum(maximum.values())<=u.TOTAL_LIMIT-reserve,'FAILED_LEG_PUBLIC_CAPACITY_UNAVAILABLE')
    encoded={name:2*size+256 for name,size in maximum.items()}
    need(max(encoded.values())<=u.LINE_LIMIT-reserve and sum(encoded.values())<=u.LOG_LIMIT-reserve,
         'FAILED_LEG_ENCODED_CAPACITY_UNAVAILABLE')
    return {'schema':'dg16.full-pair-failure-capacity.v1','authority':'NONE','base_bytes':base,
            'maximum_bytes':maximum,'raw_upper':sum(maximum.values()),'encoded_upper':sum(encoded.values()),
            'headroom':reserve,'remaining_failed_path_host_commands':14,
            'scope':'CAPACITY_ONLY_NOT_OPERATION_EVIDENCE','original_acceptance':False}
